page_title: MAI 0-2 HEI | Mainz v Heidenheim 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' Referee Florian Exner sees the trip by Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
90+3' Paul Nebel (Mainz) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Marvin Pieringer makes his way off the pitch and Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) comes on as his replacement.
86' Corner kick. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) is ready to send the ball into the box.

86' 0 - 2 Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner kick by Adrian Beck. His well-placed header ends up in the top left corner, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 0:2.
86' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
85' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 1:6.

80' It's a foul from Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim). Surprisingly, the referee comes and pulls out a red card. It was a very harsh one and Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) complains, but it's no use of course. The decision has been made.
77' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is given a yellow card.
75' Jae-Sung Lee will be replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
75' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paul Nebel (Mainz) replacing Dominik Kohr.
75' Here comes a substitution. Silvan Widmer is given a rest as he is replaced by Aymen Barkok (Mainz).
74' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) trips an opposition player and Florian Exner signals a foul.
73' Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
70' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Omar Haktab Traore will be replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) coming on for Paul Wanner.
70' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
68' The referee awards a corner and Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) goes over to take it.

67' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Robin Zentner was alert and the score remains the same.
65' My Gran could have done better! Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
62' The corner from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is intercepted by the defence.
61' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
61' The substitution is prepared. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Anthony Caci.
60' Anthony Caci (Mainz) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

60' What a great touch by Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Mainz force a corner. They send men into the box.
56' We are about to witness a subsitution. Maximilian Breunig (Heidenheim) for Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen.
56' Florian Exner shows a yellow card to Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
56' Bo Henriksen isn't happy on the touchline after referee Florian Exner shows him a yellow card.
54' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' The referee gives a yellow card to Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
49' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' What was Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
47' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Zentner intercepts the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' A pass by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45+3' The Heidenheim players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Anthony Caci (Mainz) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
42' Chance! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
38' The corner by Anthony Caci (Mainz) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
38' Anthony Caci (Mainz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
37' Anthony Caci (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a chance to score from a corner.
37' Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
32' That's the end of the game for Hyun-Seok Hong, who is replaced by Stefan Bell (Mainz).
30' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
29' RED CARD! Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Florian Exner. He can have an early bath.
27' The resulting corner, taken by Phillipp Mwene (Mainz), comes to nothing.
27' Mainz are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
22' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robin Zentner, who smothers the ball.
20' Anthony Caci (Mainz) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
20' Florian Exner blows for a foul after Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' That was close by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
15' 0 - 1 Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) meets a perfect cross from Jonas Fohrenbach deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:1.
13' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
10' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
8' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
8' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.

7' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Robin Zentner pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him. Good work from Heidenheim as they win a corner.
7' Heidenheim decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
6' Yellow card. Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
6' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
4' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Mainz will kick the game off.
Florian Exner is the one to supervise the game today.
